_why: The nightly simulation suite (.github/workflows/nightly.yml) had failed every
night for at least eight consecutive runs, 2026-08-28 through 2026-09-04, with
9 of 77 files red. It was running perfectly. Nobody could act on it, because a
workflow that is red every morning is indistinguishable from one that has just
broken -- so a genuine regression landed in it and sat there for a day without
anybody being able to see it against the noise.
This file is the noise, written down. scripts/nightly-gate.mjs fails the run
only on a file that is NOT listed here, so tomorrow's red means something new.
IT IS NOT A PLACE TO PUT FAILURES. The gate also fails when a file listed here
PASSES, which forces the list to shrink as things are fixed and stops it
becoming a permanent amnesty. Every entry carries the date it was first seen
and what it says, so the list can be read as a to-do rather than as a shrug.

tests/bb-broken-promise.test.js.note: a promise no longer firms a vote at all: 0.0988 not < 0.0851 — a calibration band, drifted

tests/bb-halting-hex.test.js.note: no hex fired in 25 seeds — the twist has become unreachable, which is this project's signature bug class and the most urgent entry here

tests/bb-knowledge.test.js.note: barely any couples formed across sixteen seasons: 36 not > 60 — showmance formation rate has fallen

tests/bb-love-triangle.test.js.note: a house triangle described with camp vocabulary — one show's words over the other, the bug class docs/ADDING-A-SHOW.md exists for

tests/bb-season-export.test.js.note: the Rivals twist recorded 15 rivalries where the export expects 1

tests/bb-theme-high-rollers.test.js.note: the floor paid each side of a split week its own tier set instead of paying the house once

tests/events-big-brother-volume.test.js.note: 22 BB events never fire in 48 seeded seasons (nightmare-*, hrr-*, wildcard-*, cliques-*, past-*) — written, registered and unreachable

tests/vp-big-brother-week.test.js.note: the visual player does not show the competition by name
